biggest_catch: The terms carry TARGETED language: the offer is only available to individuals who receive direct communication with the qualifying promo code from Atlantic Union Bank — the bank's own disclosure says receiving the disclosure on its own does not entitle you to the offer. Offer ends September 30, 2026.
catches: TARGETED language in the official terms: 'Offer is available only to individuals who receive direct communication with the qualifying Promo Code from Atlantic Union Bank (AUB). Receiving this disclosure on its own does not entitle a customer to the offer.'

Open your first new eligible AUB checking account (PRISM, Free, Loyalty, Preferred, or ThankU Checking) between July 31, 2026 and September 30, 2026 using promo code UPT8; $25 minimum opening deposit required.
Bonus tiers are based on total qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 calendar days: $1,000–$4,999.99 = $400; $5,000–$9,999.99 = $600; $10,000+ = $800.

Qualifying direct deposit = electronic deposit of regular monthly income (salary, pension, Social Security); wire transfers, P2P transfers, online/mobile deposits, and bank-to-bank transfers do NOT qualify.

Must not have owned or co-owned an AUB personal checking account in the last 12 months; 18+; valid U.S. TIN; bonus cannot be paid to nonresident aliens (Form W-8); business, fiduciary, estate, and trust accounts are not eligible.

Bonus deposited within 30 calendar days after all requirements are met; account must be open and in good standing at payout; limited to one bonus per new customer and new account; cannot be combined with any other offer.
Bonus reported to the IRS as interest on Form 1099-INT.
Atlantic Union Bank reserves the right to revoke, restrict, or change the offer at any time.
